column2: Lists every dataset the EntreVision DSS needs, where to get it, how to collect it, which model/UI feature it feeds, and a tracker to record progress.
Datasets (master list + tracker) | Collection Methods (how-to per method) | Primary Research (surveys/interviews) | Model-Data Map | Target Schema | Summary (auto-calculated progress)
Cells with a yellow fill (Status, Owner, Target date, Notes on the Datasets sheet) are for you to edit. Everything else is reference content.
P1 = needed for the core demo | P2 = strengthens accuracy/visuals | P3 = nice to have
Easy = direct download/API | Medium = needs cleaning, PDF extraction or geocoding | Hard = scattered sources, gaps, or manual compilation
API | Download | PDF extract | Scrape | Manual (curate by hand) | Survey/Interview | Derived (computed from other datasets) | Synthetic

URLs and portal names are starting points. Portals change; verify each link and check its terms of use before relying on it. Keep a 'source, date accessed' column in every table you load (see Target Schema).
Start the Agmarknet daily collector first. Live APIs usually expose only the current day's prices, so the history you want in 3 months only exists if you begin saving it now.
On Datasets, row D01 (Agmarknet daily prices) shows the level of detail expected in each field. Set its Status to 'In progress' once your collector is running.
